description: The Kpi.php file defines the Kpi class within the OrangeHRM project. It represents a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) entity with properties such as id, title, rating ranges, default status, deletion timestamp, and associated job title. The class includes ORM mappings for database persistence and incorporates the Decorator pattern via traits. It provides getter and setter methods for each property, facilitating interaction with KPI data in the system.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM annotations (e.g., ORM\Column, ORM\ManyToOne, ORM\JoinColumn)

classes.name: Kpi
classes.description: Represents a performance indicator with properties such as title, rating bounds, associated job title, and deletion timestamp. It uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping and includes methods for property access and modification.

methods.name: getId
